benefits: Zero balance bank account, RuPay debit card, Rs 2 lakh accident insurance, Rs 30000 life insurance, overdraft facility up to Rs 10000
application_process: Apply at any bank branch with Aadhaar/ID proof and address proof
description_en: Financial inclusion programme ensuring access to financial services like banking, savings & deposit accounts, remittance, credit, insurance, pension.
description_hi: वित्तीय समावेश कार्यक्रम जो बैंकिंग, बचत और जमा खाते, प्रेषण, ऋण, बीमा, पेंशन जैसी वित्तीय सेवाओं तक पहुंच सुनिश्चित करता है।

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Subsidy up to Rs 2.67 lakh for home loans, affordable housing for all
application_process: Apply through PMAY portal or Common Service Centre (CSC)
description_en: Affordable housing scheme providing central assistance to EWS/LIG/MIG categories for construction or enhancement of houses.
description_hi: आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर/निम्न आय/मध्यम आय वर्ग को मकान निर्माण या सुधार के लिए केंद्रीय सहायता प्रदान करने वाली किफायती आवास योजना।

benefits: Rs 6000 per year in three equal instalments directly to bank account
application_process: Register through PM-KISAN portal, CSC or State Agriculture Department
description_en: Income support of Rs 6000 per year to all land holding farmer families to supplement their financial needs.
description_hi: सभी भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को उनकी वित्तीय जरूरतों को पूरा करने के लिए प्रति वर्ष 6000 रुपये की आय सहायता।

ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefits: Free LPG connection with deposit-free cylinder, first refill and stove free of cost
application_process: Apply through LPG distributor with BPL card, Aadhaar, and bank details
description_en: Free LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households to reduce health hazards from cooking with fossil fuels.
description_hi: BPL परिवारों की महिलाओं को जीवाश्म ईंधन से खाना पकाने के स्वास्थ्य खतरों को कम करने के लिए मुफ्त एलपीजी कनेक्शन।

benefits: High interest savings account (currently 8.2%), tax benefits under 80C, maturity at age 21
application_process: Open account at any Post Office or authorized bank with birth certificate
description_en: Small savings scheme for the girl child with attractive interest rate and tax benefits to build a fund for her education and marriage.
description_hi: बालिकाओं के लिए आकर्षक ब्याज दर और कर लाभ के साथ छोटी बचत योजना।

scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
benefits: 100 days guaranteed wage employment per year, unemployment allowance if work not provided within 15 days
application_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat with photo and age proof
description_en: Legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
description_hi: ग्रामीण परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष 100 दिन के गारंटीकृत मजदूरी रोजगार की कानूनी गारंटी।

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefits: Health insurance cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year, cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals
application_process: Check eligibility on mera.pmjay.gov.in or call 14555
description_en: World's largest health insurance scheme providing Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation.
description_hi: 5 लाख रुपये प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष का स्वास्थ्य बीमा कवर।

benefits: Loans up to Rs 10 lakh without collateral: Shishu (up to 50K), Kishore (50K-5L), Tarun (5L-10L)
application_process: Apply at any bank, NBFC, or MFI with business plan
description_en: Micro-enterprise development loans for non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises up to Rs 10 lakh.
description_hi: गैर-कॉर्पोरेट, गैर-कृषि लघु/सूक्ष्म उद्यमों के लिए 10 लाख रुपये तक के ऋण।

benefits: Pension after retirement, tax benefits under 80CCD, partial withdrawal allowed
application_process: Register through eNPS portal or Point of Presence (PoP)
description_en: Voluntary defined contribution pension system for citizens to build a retirement corpus.
description_hi: सेवानिवृत्ति कोष बनाने के लिए स्वैच्छिक अंशदान पेंशन प्रणाली।

benefits: Bank loans between Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore for greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading
application_process: Apply through Stand Up India portal or bank branches
description_en: Facilitating bank loans to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises.
description_hi: SC/ST और महिला उद्यमियों को ग्रीनफील्ड उद्यम स्थापित करने के लिए बैंक ऋण।

benefits: Crop insurance at premium of 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial crops
application_process: Apply through CSC, bank, or PMFBY portal before sowing season
description_en: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage.
description_hi: फसल हानि/क्षति से पीड़ित किसानों को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करने वाली व्यापक फसल बीमा योजना।

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits: Rs 5000 cash incentive for first living child in three instalments for pregnant and lactating mothers
application_process: Register at Anganwadi Centre or approved health facility
description_en: Maternity benefit for pregnant and lactating mothers for first living child to improve health seeking behaviour.
description_hi: पहले जीवित बच्चे के लिए गर्भवती और स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं के लिए मातृत्व लाभ।

benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of Rs 1000-5000 per month after age 60
application_process: Enroll through bank with savings account and Aadhaar
description_en: Pension scheme for unorganised sector workers guaranteeing minimum pension after age 60.
description_hi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के कामगारों के लिए 60 वर्ष की आयु के बाद न्यूनतम पेंशन की गारंटी।

benefits: Monthly pension: Rs 200-500 for elderly, Rs 300 for widows, Rs 300 for disabled persons
application_process: Apply through District Social Welfare Officer or Panchayat
description_en: Social security for elderly, widows, disabled belonging to below poverty line (BPL) households.
description_hi: BPL परिवारों के बुजुर्गों, विधवाओं, विकलांग व्यक्तियों के लिए सामाजिक सुरक्षा।

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
benefits: 5 kg free foodgrain per person per month under NFSA
application_process: Ration card holders automatically eligible, collect from Fair Price Shop
description_en: Free foodgrain distribution to priority households and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families.
description_hi: प्राथमिकता वाले परिवारों को मुफ्त खाद्यान्न वितरण।

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits: Awareness about girl child education, prevention of gender biased sex selection, survival and education of girl child
application_process: District level programmes and Sukanya Samriddhi account linkage
description_en: Multi-sectoral intervention to address declining child sex ratio and empower the girl child through education.
description_hi: गिरते बाल लिंगानुपात को संबोधित करने और शिक्षा के माध्यम से बालिकाओं को सशक्त बनाने के लिए बहु-क्षेत्रीय हस्तक्षेप।

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
benefits: Life insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh at premium of Rs 436 per year, auto-debit from bank account
application_process: Enroll through bank branch, online banking, or insurance company
description_en: Affordable life insurance scheme providing Rs 2 lakh coverage on death due to any reason.
description_hi: किसी भी कारण से मृत्यु पर 2 लाख रुपये का कवरेज।

benefits: Accident insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh (death) or Rs 1 lakh (partial disability) at premium of Rs 20 per year
application_process: Enroll through bank branch or online banking
description_en: Affordable accident insurance scheme with annual premium of just Rs 20.
description_hi: मात्र 20 रुपये वार्षिक प्रीमियम के साथ किफायती दुर्घटना बीमा योजना।

benefits: Free skill training, certification, monetary reward of Rs 8000, placement assistance
application_process: Register through Skill India portal or training centres
description_en: Short-term skill training and certification for youth to improve employability.
description_hi: युवाओं की रोजगार क्षमता में सुधार के लिए अल्पकालिक कौशल प्रशिक्षण।

benefits: Free digital literacy training, subsidised internet access in rural areas, e-governance services
application_process: Register through CSC or Digital India portal
description_en: Programme to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy.
description_hi: भारत को डिजिटल रूप से सशक्त समाज में बदलने का कार्यक्रम।

scheme_name: PM SVANidhi - PM Street Vendors AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Working capital loan up to Rs 50000 without collateral, 7% interest subsidy, digital payment incentive
application_process: Apply through PM SVANidhi portal with Certificate of Vending
description_en: Microcredit scheme for street vendors to resume livelihoods affected by COVID-19.
description_hi: पथ विक्रेताओं के लिए सूक्ष्म ऋण योजना।

benefits: All-weather road connectivity to unconnected habitations with population of 500+
application_process: Through State Rural Roads Development Agency
description_en: Providing all-weather road connectivity to unconnected rural habitations.
description_hi: असंबद्ध ग्रामीण बस्तियों को हर मौसम में सड़क संपर्क।

benefits: Self-help group formation, revolving fund of Rs 15000, community investment fund, skill training, bank linkage
application_process: Form SHG through local block office or existing SHG federation
description_en: Reducing poverty by building strong institutions of the poor, especially women, and enabling them to access gainful self-employment.
description_hi: गरीबों की मजबूत संस्थाओं का निर्माण कर गरीबी कम करना।

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits: Supplementary nutrition, immunisation, health check-ups, referral services, nutrition and health education, pre-school non-formal education
application_process: Through Anganwadi Centres
description_en: Comprehensive services for children below 6 years and pregnant/lactating women for nutrition, health, and education.
description_hi: 6 वर्ष से कम आयु के बच्चों और गर्भवती/स्तनपान कराने वाली महिलाओं के लिए पोषण, स्वास्थ्य सेवाएं।

benefits: Financial assistance for toilet construction (Rs 12000 for rural), solid and liquid waste management
application_process: Apply through Gram Panchayat or Swachh Bharat portal
description_en: Mission to achieve universal sanitation coverage and eliminate open defecation.
description_hi: सार्वभौमिक स्वच्छता कवरेज प्राप्त करने और खुले में शौच को समाप्त करने का मिशन।

benefits: Free and compulsory education (6-14 years), mid-day meals, scholarships for meritorious students
application_process: Enrollment through schools, scholarship through National Scholarship Portal
description_en: Supporting quality education aligned with the National Education Policy 2020.
description_hi: राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति 2020 के अनुरूप गुणवत्तापूर्ण शिक्षा का समर्थन।

benefits: Portability of ration card benefits across states, can avail entitled food grains from any Fair Price Shop in India
application_process: Aadhaar-linked ration card, biometric authentication at FPS
description_en: Enabling migrant workers and their families to access PDS benefits from any Fair Price Shop across India.
description_hi: प्रवासी श्रमिकों को भारत भर में किसी भी उचित मूल्य दुकान से राशन लाभ।

benefits: Monthly pension of Rs 3000 after age 60, equal government contribution
application_process: Register through CSC with Aadhaar and savings bank account
description_en: Voluntary pension scheme for unorganised sector workers with monthly income up to Rs 15000.
description_hi: 15000 रुपये तक मासिक आय वाले असंगठित क्षेत्र के कामगारों के लिए स्वैच्छिक पेंशन योजना।

scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihood Mission (DAY-NULM)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Self-employment programme, skill training, shelter for urban homeless, subsidised bank credit
application_process: Apply through ULB or State Mission Office
description_en: Reducing poverty and vulnerability of urban poor by enabling them to access gainful self-employment and skilled wage employment.
description_hi: शहरी गरीबों को स्वरोजगार और कुशल मजदूरी रोजगार तक पहुँच।

benefits: Financial compensation to victims of crime including sexual assault, acid attack, human trafficking. Amount varies Rs 3-10 lakh depending on state and offence
application_process: Apply through District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) or State Legal Services Authority
description_en: Compensation to victims of crime as per BNSS provisions and state-specific schemes. Linked to BNS sections on sexual offences, acid attack, and trafficking.
description_hi: अपराध के पीड़ितों को BNSS प्रावधानों के अनुसार मुआवजा।

benefits: Free legal representation in courts, free legal advice, Lok Adalat services, legal awareness camps
application_process: Apply at District Legal Services Authority or Taluka Legal Services Committee
description_en: Free legal services to weaker sections of society under Legal Services Authorities Act 1987. Covers women, SC/ST, persons in custody, industrial workmen, disabled, victims of disasters.
description_hi: कानूनी सेवा प्राधिकरण अधिनियम 1987 के तहत समाज के कमजोर वर्गों को मुफ्त कानूनी सेवाएं।

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits: One Stop Centres (Sakhi), Women Helpline 181, Mahila Police Volunteers, emergency response support system
application_process: Access through 181 helpline, One Stop Centres, or nearest police station
description_en: Safety and security initiatives for women including One Stop Centres providing integrated support and assistance under one roof to women affected by violence.
description_hi: हिंसा से प्रभावित महिलाओं को एक छत के नीचे एकीकृत सहायता।

scheme_name: SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act Support
benefits: Enhanced penalties for atrocities against SC/STs, relief and rehabilitation, special courts, victim compensation Rs 85000-825000
application_process: File complaint at police station, approach District Magistrate or DLSA
description_en: Protection and relief measures for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes against atrocities under the PoA Act.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जाति और जनजाति के विरुद्ध अत्याचार से सुरक्षा।

benefits: Free access to case status, cause lists, court orders, daily orders through e-Courts portal and mobile app
application_process: Access through ecourts.gov.in portal or eCourts Services mobile app
description_en: Digital platform providing free access to court information for citizens.
description_hi: नागरिकों के लिए न्यायालय की जानकारी तक मुफ्त पहुंच का डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म।

benefits: Free legal consultation through video conferencing at CSCs, panel lawyers available in 12+ languages
application_process: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) and request Tele-Law consultation
description_en: Mainstreaming legal aid to the marginalised through pre-litigation advice via video conferencing from CSCs.
description_hi: सीएससी से वीडियो कॉन्फ्रेंसिंग के माध्यम से मुफ्त कानूनी परामर्श।
